Tipster, also known as ItsYaBoiTipster, and formerly GamerGeekReview, is an American YouTuber, livestreamer, and commentator primarily known for reporting news on YouTube and commentating on current events. Content With his videos reporting news on YouTubers and other events that happen online, the content on his channel covers the fields of Youtube commentary, and online drama, as well as the political space. This is usually accompanied with background footage, particularly gaming material. Tipster has a smaller YouTube channel called "Tipster Speedrunning" (also called "TipsterPlaysGames", according to the channel's URL). This channel rather serves as his own gaming channel, and in particular, his content revolves around posting highlights of his casual speedrunning through his personal favorite classic games. So far, he has uploaded gameplay Resident Evil 2 and Goldeneye 007. This channel was recently repurposed to "Tipster #Shorts" where he uploads short videos using YouTube's new Shorts feature. History He launched his YouTube channel on November 21, 2006. He started uploading in 2006, and the style of his videos were similar to Cinemassacre. However, the earliest public video on his channel is a livestream titled "Live Discussion About YouTube Advertising Policy Misinformation", uploaded on September 2, 2016. Most of the videos predating this stream were mostly privated, with a few early videos taken down for copyright infringement. In 2017, his videos were news about games, but over time, he moved on to more general topics, and during that time, he gained recognition, views, and subscribers. On October 17, 2019, he launched his speedrunning channel and started uploading his speedrunning highlights in late December 2020.
